title: Compose the selected page layout independently of content
steps: Run layout resolve with explicit choice or known existing profile; obtain a choice for a new document without one.
For exam-two-column, reuse column-major slots and the first-page heading; for reference-single-column, use the reference flow procedure P-reference-layout.
Derive slot heights or content flow for this exam; surface overflow explicitly.
Preserve section controls and inspect native page/question starts.
outputs: selected profile and separately selected format
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
